requests.text: I need to send the checkout mock to a teammate for review. What phone-sized preview should they open to see the order review drawer already open? Please leave the mock as is.
requests.expectation: Give a usable session preview for checkout, mobile, review-open. A fresh open has the Order review drawer visible. No source changes.

requests.text: Before I sign off on the phone mock, can you measure how wide and tall the Place order button actually renders on the checkout screen and tell me if both dimensions meet a 44-pixel touch target? Please do not edit anything.
requests.expectation: Report measured CSS pixel dimensions for place-order in the mobile default checkout, and correctly compare each to 44. Static source or a clean lint is not enough. No source changes.

requests.text: I’m writing a QA note. Could you run the phone demo from browsing to confirmation and give me a small table with what the reviewer does, what they should see, and what the prototype check actually observed? Don’t change the mock.
requests.expectation: Use the existing mobile catalog-to-confirmation journey and match observed outcomes with the prototype: Review order, checkout, select Pro, Place order, and confirmation. No source changes.

requests.text: Could you make a phone screenshot of the checkout mock with Price details already expanded, so I can attach it to my review? I want the price breakdown called out in the image. Please share where I can find the screenshot without changing the design.
requests.expectation: A genuine mobile checkout screenshot for prices-open highlighting price-breakdown. Verify a readable 390 px PNG in the project screenshot cache with the total shown and no source changes.

requests.text: For our handover rehearsal, please add a small “Need help?” section to the confirmation screen of this mock. Start collapsed. When opened, show “This demo does not place real orders.” and a “Back to catalog” action that goes to the catalog. Please check that I can use it on a phone and share the preview.
requests.expectation: Persist a collapsed-by-default disclosure on confirmation; it reveals the demo note and a working back-to-catalog control. Phone preview loads, the requested interaction works, and unrelated screens stay unchanged.

preview.visible: This demo does not place real orders.
